messages:
maria: Quick question — when we show inline example matches in the route editor, should they be live-validated against the YAML schema and lint rules?
kevin: Preferably yes. Authors expect instant feedback. But we need to avoid noisy errors while they're typing.
noah: +1. Maybe we debounce validation and show a transient 'draft' state that doesn't block saving.
sasha: UX thought: show a tiny 'Test input' panel where you paste headers/body and it highlights which matcher fired.
maria: Love that. Also would be useful to show which fallback will be selected if multiple rules match.
kevin: Implementation idea: reuse the runtime matcher library server-side and expose a /preview endpoint that returns matching route id + explain plan.
noah: That'd be great for parity with prod routing. We must ensure privacy — preview should run in sandbox and not persist inputs.
lint-bot: lint: header-matcher-ordering: potential ambiguous anchor between `x-customer-tier` and `x-customer` at line 12
maria: Example YAML I'm seeing:
```
route:
  id: route-42
  match:
    - header:
        name: x-customer
        value: ^enterprise\b
    - header:
        name: x-customer-tier
        value: ^enterprise-premium$
  actions:
    - set: backend: premium
```

maria: Lint flagged because `x-customer` is a prefix of `x-customer-tier`.
kevin: We could have the linter detect prefix collisions and offer an autofix: suggest anchoring (`^` / `$`) or promote explicit `header_exact` matcher.
sasha: For the console, instead of blocking save, show a yellow warning with a 'Why?' tooltip and a one-click 'Apply suggested fix' button.
noah: Tests: add unit tests covering cases where prefix matcher should not override exact match. Also add end-to-end test in the preview endpoint.
maria: How to present the autofix diff? Small modal with a diff view and a 'commit to draft' action.
kevin: Also add a 'run canonicalization' action that normalizes spaces, sorts matchers in a stable order, and removes redundant rules.
sasha: UX nit: don't reorder matchers without explicit user action. Reordering can change semantics.
kevin: Good call. Canonicalize only when user clicks 'Normalize' and show a preview of the resulting YAML.
lint-bot: suggestion: add example payloads to the route schema so linter can run example-based checks
maria: Yes — schema addition: `examples: { headers: { ... }, body: '...' }` and validate matchers across examples.
noah: Security: redact sensitive header values in stored examples, or mark examples ephemeral (not saved to backend) by default.
sasha: For rollout UX, we should let authors attach a small test set of examples and a 'regression guard' that rejects rollouts that fail N% of examples.
kevin: Implementation plan: 1) add preview endpoint; 2) extend linter rules for prefix collisions; 3) console UI: test panel + warnings + autofix modal; 4) tests and docs.
maria: Timeline? Can we spike preview endpoint next week?
noah: I can take the spike — will prototype with the runtime matcher lib in a sandbox container.
maria: Great. Add tickets and link the spike PR when ready. :thumbsup:
lint-bot: created ticket RI-8452 for matcher-preview-spike
kevin: Thanks team. Quick follow-up: we should also log preview runs in telemetry (non-sensitive) so we can see common false positives.
sasha: Agreed. Keep PII out. Maybe sample matcher patterns + match counts.
maria: OK I'll draft the UX mock with the test panel and an 'apply autofix' flow and post it to #eng-platform-design.
noah: I'll post the prototype link in this thread when ready.
kevin: closing loop — if anyone wants to join the spike DMs open.
